title: Terms for Moving a Security Deposits Deposit to a New Cedar Fork Location
content:
On a tier whose terms allow it, a member moving within the Cedar Fork territory may ask that a held Security Deposits deposit follow them to the new service account instead of being applied to the old one's final bill.

## Conditions of the transfer

The deposit may follow the member only when all three of these hold, each read from the cooperative's service account records:

1. the old service account is final billed with an account balance of exactly zero after the final bill is paid;
2. the new service account belongs to the same member;
3. the new service account is mapped to the same deposit tier.

## Effect of the transfer

The paid-in-full date and the accrued interest carry over, so the refund review keeps counting from the original date. The new service account then needs no new-service deposit for the amount transferred.

## Condition table

| Old account final billed with a zero balance | New account of the same member | Same deposit tier | May the deposit follow |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | yes | yes |
| no (a balance of $0.01 or more remains, or the account is not final billed) | yes | yes | no |
| yes | no | yes | no |
| yes | yes | no | no |

## Hypothetical illustrations

- A member with a Residential Standard Deposit paid in full on May 2, 2025 moves to another Schedule R home; the old account is final billed and paid to a zero balance. The deposit follows, and its refund review still counts from May 2, 2025.
- A member on the Farm Service Deposit moves to a Schedule R home, whose tier is the Residential Standard Deposit; the tiers differ and the deposit does not follow.
